description: This file contains unit tests for the ResourceIdentifier class, verifying parsing, creation, equality, and handling of resource identifier strings and paths.

classes.name: ResourceIdentifierTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of ResourceIdentifier class, including parsing from string/path, equality, and edge case handling.

methods.name: testFromStringAllowsMissingDeviceId
methods.description: Verifies parsing of resource identifier string with missing device ID.

methods.name: testFromStringAllowsEmptyPathSegments
methods.description: Verifies parsing when path segments are empty or contain multiple slashes.

methods.name: testFromStringAssumingDefaultTenantAllowsMissingDeviceId
methods.description: Tests creating a resource identifier with default tenant when only endpoint is provided.

methods.name: testFromStringWithExtendedPath
methods.description: Ensures extended path segments are correctly parsed.

methods.name: testFromStringSupportsSingleSegment
methods.description: Checks creation and parsing of a resource identifier with a single segment.

methods.name: testFromPathSupportsSingleSegment
methods.description: Checks creation from path array with a single segment.

methods.name: testFromSupportsSingleSegment
methods.description: Checks creation from individual parameters for a single segment.

methods.name: testFromIndividualParameters
methods.description: Validates resource identifier creation from explicit segment parameters.

methods.name: testFromAllowsMissingDeviceId
methods.description: Verifies creating a resource identifier with null device ID.

methods.name: testEqualsReturnsTrueForSameEndpointAndTenant
methods.description: Ensures equality comparison recognizes identical identifiers with same endpoint and tenant.

methods.name: testHashCodeReturnsSameValueForSameEndpointAndTenant
methods.description: Checks hash code consistency for identifiers with same endpoint and tenant.

methods.name: testFromPathAllowsTrailingNulls
methods.description: Tests creating resource identifier from path array with trailing null fragments.

methods.name: testFromPathAllowsNullSegments
methods.description: Tests creating resource identifier with null segments at non-trailing positions.

methods.name: testFromPathFailsForPathStartingWithNullSegment
methods.description: Verifies that path starting with null segment throws IllegalArgumentException.
